The Clovers face a difficult challenge, because AS Roma is impressive in its form in European cups, winning the previous four matches, including the last one against VfB Stuttgart (2-0). Panathinaikos AO has also not lost in four matches, but in its case it is divided into two wins and draws. In the previous match, the Greek team drew with Ferencvaros (1:1)

programme.title: Football: UEFA Europa League. Aston Villa FC – FC Salzburg
programme.desc: The hosts are impressive in their form both domestically and in European cups. In the current edition of the Europa League, they lost only once - to Go Ahead Eagles (1-2), but since then they have won four in a row, including the last one over Fenerbahce (1-0). Aston Villa is already certain of promotion, taking second place in the table. The situation of the Austrians is definitely more difficult. RB Salzburg managed to win only two games and lost five. It takes a distant 28th place in the classification, and in order to advance to the play-off phase of the 1/16 finals, it must win in Birmingham and count on its rivals' mistakes.

programme.title: Football: Conference League. Rayo Vallecano – Lech Poznań
programme.desc: In the 3rd series of matches of the regular round, a difficult test awaits Kolejorz, who will face Rayo Vallecano away. However, the Polish champion has a lot of experience when it comes to playing in European cups. He should approach the clash with the eighth force of the previous LaLiga season without any complexes and with faith in victory. Lech fans are counting on a repeat of 2022, when the Poznań locomotive won LK 3-0 against Villarreal

programme.title: Football: Conference League. KF Shkendija – Jagiellonia Białystok
programme.desc: The Pride of Podlasie started the league phase of the youngest UEFA competition with a modest victory over Hamrun Spartans 1-0. In the second round, Adrian Siemieniec's players faced the strong RC Strasbourg, drawing with them away 1-1. Now they are on a delegation to Skopje. KF Shkendija has a 0-2 defeat against Rayo Vallecano and a 1-0 victory over Shelbourne FC. Jagiellonia will be the favorite in the match at the stadium. Todor Proeski. If only she would play her role better than the Lech Poznań players in the confrontation with Lincoln Red Imps from Gibraltar

programme.title: Football: Conference League. Lech Poznań – FC Lausanne-Sport
programme.desc: Kolejorz lost the previous two matches in the Conference League - first, they unexpectedly lost to Lincoln Red Imps 1-2, and then they lost to Rayo Vallecano (2-3). Stopping the bad series against the undefeated team from Switzerland in this edition of the competition will not be an easy task

programme.title: Football: Conference League. Raków Częstochowa – SK Rapid Vienna
programme.desc: The team from Częstochowa, which is in twelfth place in the Conference League table, will play against the team that is closing the table. On October 2, Lech Poznań defeated Rapid Wien 4:1. Will Fran Tudor and his colleagues from Raków follow in Kolejorz's footsteps?

programme.title: Football: Conference League. Legia Warszawa – AC Sparta Prague
programme.desc: At the beginning of November, Military, plunged into crisis, even lost at home to Bruk-Bet Termalica. They're not doing too well in the UEFA Conference League either. After three rounds, they only have three points on the counter. If they do not score points against Sparta, their advancement to the play-offs will become unlikely

programme.title: Boxing: Gala in San Diego – summary
programme.desc: During the gala in San Diego, Emanuel Navarrete will defend his WBO World super featherweight belt for the fifth time. The undefeated Filipino, Charly Suarez, for whom this is his first such a prestigious fight, will try to take the title away from him

programme.title: Football: Polonia Warszawa – Śląsk Wrocław – Betclic 1. Liga
programme.desc: The previous clash between Polonia and Śląsk ended with a division of points. However, this will not satisfy both sides in this meeting. The stake of this match is to get closer to the long-awaited return to the Ekstraklasa

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Lech Poznań – GKS Katowice
programme.desc: The guests are one of those teams that can easily beat the favorite or lose to a team at the bottom of the table. In the 14th series of games, GiEKSa failed to cope with Korona, which was escaping from the relegation zone, and in the next match it won after an exciting match against the very good Cracovia (4:3). I wonder which face of the Katowice team we will see in the clash with Kolejorz. Lech, despite leading in the table, can also surprise in the negative. At the beginning of November, he lost in Niepołomice, losing 0:2 to Puszcza, who was last in the table at that time. He lost only once at home. In October, Motor brought a set of points from Bułgarska

Women's soccer: World Cup qualifiers: Poland - Ireland
programme.desc: The White and Reds will fight in Gdańsk for their first victory in the qualifications for next year's world championships in Brazil. They lost 1:4 with France and drew 2:2 with the Netherlands. A win against the Irish will not only give them 3 points, but will also give them confidence before the second match against their rivals from the British Isles 4 days later

programme.title: Football: STS Polish Cup – summary of the semi-finals
programme.desc: The most interesting moments of the battle for the final of the national cup will be presented. In the semi-final we watched the clash of the fourth league Zawisza Bydgoszcz with Górnik Zabrze and Raków Częstochowa with GKS Katowice

programme.title: Boxing – middleweight: Brandon Adams – Caoimhin Agyarko – Gala in Las Vegas
programme.desc: In the main event of the gala in Las Vegas, Brandon Adams will face Caoimhin Agyarko. The American boasts a record of 24-6. Recently, only Andreas Katzourakis managed to beat him. We will see if the undefeated boxer from Northern Ireland will be able to add a 7th defeat to his record and thus extend his series of victories.

programme.title: Sports evening
programme.desc: A summary of the most important information from the past day from the world of sports in a short film and an announcement of upcoming events. The hosts also talk to the most famous athletes and trainers from Poland and around the world... news program

programme.title: Boxing: Polish Boxing League: Pomorzanin Boxing Team Toruń – Concordia Knurów
programme.desc: After two rounds, Concordia has full points and is fighting for the leadership position with Rushh Kielce and Imperium Boxing Wałbrzych. He will try to outdo his rivals in a competition with a Pomeranian. The team from Toruń had to wait for their first victory this season to face the boxers from Nowy Sącz, against whom they won 10:8

programme.title: Boxing: Fight for the interim WBC World belt in Quebec - super middleweight: Christian Mbilli - Maciej Sulęcki
programme.desc: Undefeated Christian Mbilli versus experienced Maciej Sulęcki in the fight for the interim WBC World super middleweight belt. For the Frenchman, this is the first fight for a title of this rank. The Pole is fighting to return to the elite. In February, he defeated Ali Akhmedov by technical knockout

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Motor Lublin – Raków Częstochowa
programme.desc: The match between Motor Lublin and Raków Częstochowa will be a great experience for the fans of both teams. The hosts return to the Ekstraklasa after over three decades. In turn, Medalik fans are extremely curious about how their team will perform under the leadership of Marek Papszun, who returns to the bench.

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Korona Kielce – Jagiellonia Białystok
programme.desc: After the 29th round of last season, Jagiellonia Białystok had 55 points, exactly the same as now at the same stage of the competition. At that time, such achievements were enough to be the leader of PKO BP Ekstraklasa. Currently, the Pride of Podlasie is four points behind the leader Raków and must get to work to defend the title. In this situation, a win against Korona Kielce is a must

programme.desc: Since it became clear that coach Aleksandar Vuković would not extend his contract, which expires at the end of the season, Piast Gliwice started playing much worse. The team from Gliwice will try to take advantage of the crisis, while the Pogoń Szczecin players are still secretly dreaming of a place on the podium.

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Widzew Łódź – Bruk-Bet Termalica Nieciecza
programme.desc: After the victory against Lech Poznań, the hosts relaxed a bit and ended the next three matches with a division of points. These results did not allow them to leave the red zone. Bruk-Bet Termalica Nieciecza, after a long series without a win, finally won, leaving Piast Gliwice defeated.

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: KGHM Zagłębie Lubin – Radomiak Radom
programme.desc: After two defeats in a row, most recently against Motor Lublin (0:1), Zagłębie Lubin players dropped out of the top three of the PKO BP Ekstraklasa. Now they will try to get revenge against Radomiak Radom, with whom they lost the match in the autumn round 1:3

programme.title: Football: Ekstraklasa: Legia Warszawa – Górnik Zabrze
programme.desc: The league classic evokes great emotions among fans, regardless of the places occupied by both distinguished clubs at a given moment. Legia Warszawa, still looking for its own style under the leadership of Goncalo Feio, cannot afford another slip-up in front of its home crowd. We will see if Górnik Zabrze will be able to surprise the Military team with something

programme.title: Hero from the Shadow – Bruk-Bet Termalica Nieciecza | E03
programme.desc: Krzysztof Kozik has been the manager of the first team of Bruk-Bet Termalica Nieciecza for 20 years. He has been a resident of Nieciecza since birth. Kozik, known as Kiero, was also an active player and scored 245 goals for the team in the lower leagues. Poland. documentary series

programme.title: 30 for 30: The Philly Special
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: d/s Dynasty. Shubenkovs
programme.desc: The series about the three-hundred-year history of the Romanov dynasty in Russia is designed for the widest audience, but the time frame of the events described is somewhat wider than the reign of the Romanov dynasty. The geography of the series is also very extensive. In addition to Moscow, the authors visited Vladimir, Uglich, Kostroma, St. Petersburg and its environs. The Belarusian Mogilev, which for two years was practically the third capital of Russia for two years, was not ignored. In addition, the seaside cities of Azov, Taganrog and Livadia were not forgotten. The film uses rare footage of the Valaam archipelago, where Alexander I made a pilgrimage, asking for blessings for his feat. The main task of the authors of the series can be considered that they tried to tell the audience a three-hundred-year history popularly and vividly, without archival dust. Director: Alexey Pishchulin. Cast: Andrey Smirnov, Andrey Bogdanov, Denis Solodovnikov, Sergey Nilov, Nina Sorotokina, Evgeny Anisimov. Russia, 2013, biography

S3, Ep3 «Africa's Hunters»…If the tiny Nsefu pride is to survive, the teen Misfit and his older brother must quickly perfect their hunting skills. Trek into enemy territory as the lions face dominant rivals and a powerful hyena clan in the search for prey | Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. programme.title: Zambia Untamed: Living on the Edge (S1E2). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. JAV, 2018. S1, Ep2
programme.desc: 2018 г. Год: 2018. Страна: JAV. Год: 2018. S1, Ep2 «Zambia Untamed»…The plains and woodlands of the Luangwa Valley are the wildest and most merciless of all neighbourhoods where duels between predator and prey are played out both day and night. For the animals that call this home, it's a daily battle to stay alive | Compelling wildlife documentary series that follows a group of animals who live in a magical corner of Zambia- extraordinary Luangwa Valley. Meet the colourful and engaging characters who call this place home- a baby elephant, baboon born an outsider and many others, and see how they struggle to survive | Director: Mitch Turnbull

programme.title: Mysteries Of the Mekong: Cambodia: Hidden Refuges (S1E7). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Kanada, 2020. S1, Ep7
programme.desc: 2020 г. Год: 2020. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2020. S1, Ep7 «Mysteries Of the Mekong»…Cambodia is a country that lies almost entirely within the Mekong basin, flanked by Thailand, Laos and Vietnam. The Mekong travels the length of the country entering in the north and tracking south, cutting the region into two halves. Every habitat here is somehow linked to the Mekong's waters. Whether it be it's tributaries which connect and traverse much of the countries terrain, or the seasonal flooding that influences landscapes miles beyond its reach | Travel one of the mightiest waterways in the world as this journey along the Mekong River takes us across a cornucopia of diverse landscapes starting from its source high up in the Tibetan Plateau in China, We follow the meandering route through Laos and its western border with Thailand, one of the most pristine natural habitats on the planet dominated by abundant forests full of enchanting flora and fauna and a complex river system that feeds into the Mekong. From there, its path continues through Cambodia and, finally, into Vietnam where the majestic delta splits into nine channels that feed into the South China Sea. Each epsiode focuses on a particular section of the river and, along the way, we get to meet such creatures as snub-nosed monkeys, high-flying birds and never before filmed cave dwellers | Director: Oliver Page | Cast: Leila Monks

programme.title: Mysteries Of the Mekong: Cambodia: Hidden Refuges (S1E7). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Kanada, 2020. S1, Ep7
programme.desc: 2020 г. Год: 2020. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2020. S1, Ep7 «Mysteries Of the Mekong»…Cambodia is a country that lies almost entirely within the Mekong basin, flanked by Thailand, Laos and Vietnam. The Mekong travels the length of the country entering in the north and tracking south, cutting the region into two halves. Every habitat here is somehow linked to the Mekong's waters. Whether it be it's tributaries which connect and traverse much of the countries terrain, or the seasonal flooding that influences landscapes miles beyond its reach | Travel one of the mightiest waterways in the world as this journey along the Mekong River takes us across a cornucopia of diverse landscapes starting from its source high up in the Tibetan Plateau in China, We follow the meandering route through Laos and its western border with Thailand, one of the most pristine natural habitats on the planet dominated by abundant forests full of enchanting flora and fauna and a complex river system that feeds into the Mekong. From there, its path continues through Cambodia and, finally, into Vietnam where the majestic delta splits into nine channels that feed into the South China Sea. Each epsiode focuses on a particular section of the river and, along the way, we get to meet such creatures as snub-nosed monkeys, high-flying birds and never before filmed cave dwellers | Director: Oliver Page | Cast: Leila Monks

programme.title: HISTORY'S GREATEST MYSTERIES S4 EP19

programme.title: THE SECRET OF SKINWALKER RANCH S4 EP14

programme.title: 10 ĐỐI 10 (MÙA 3) - 10 FIGHT 10 SEASON 3
programme.desc: Chương trình quy tụ các siêu sao, ca sĩ, võ sĩ, người mẫu và rapper Thái Lan vào sàn đấu quyền anh nổi tiếng. Phần 2 có trận đấu đầu tiên của nữ Thái Lan và Phần 3 có hai vận động viên giành huy chương vàng Thế vận hội cạnh tranh chức vô địch. Chương trình đấm bốc độc đáo này mang đến sự giải trí toàn diện, với các buổi biểu diễn trực tiếp, trang phục xa hoa và những trận chiến đẫm máu thực sự!

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ quân nhân ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị Lực lượng Đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thử thách trên bộ, trên biển và trên không. Những nữ quân nhân dự bị hàng đầu thành lập các đội gồm bốn người để thi đấu với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cùng trước sáu người dẫn chương trình nổi tiếng!

programme.title: GIÁO PHÁI BÁO THÙ - WU LIN: THE SOCIETY
programme.desc: Lấy bối cảnh năm 2050, nơi tình trạng ô nhiễm và virus tràn lan buộc mọi người phải đeo khẩu trang chỉ để thở, tuy nhiên cuộc sống hàng ngày vẫn tiếp tục như thường lệ. Khi hàng loạt cái chết bí ẩn nổ ra, cảnh sát nghi ngờ kẻ giết người hàng loạt trong khi có tin đồn về một con quỷ đang nổi cơn thịnh nộ. Giờ đây, cảnh sát phải chạy đua để làm sáng tỏ bí ẩn và ngăn chặn các vụ giết người trước khi sự hoảng loạn bao trùm thành phố.

programme.title: QUYẾT ĐẤU LỤC NHĨ MỸ HẦU - THE MACAQUE MONKEY
programme.desc: Thế giới hỗn loạn sau khi cây sự sống bị đốt cháy. Tôn Ngộ Không quyết định quay về quá khứ để hồi sinh nó, nhưng thần lực của anh không ổn định sau khi mất chiếc vòng vàng, và anh phải tìm lại bản thân lúc trẻ để hợp sức tìm kiếm sức mạnh thời gian. Vì Khỉ Macaque sáu tai cũng muốn có sức mạnh của thời gian nên chúng đụng độ nhau trong một trận chiến khốc liệt…

programme.title: QUẢ BÓNG THÉP - IRON BALL
programme.desc: Chương trình giải trí thể thao này quy tụ lực lượng đặc biệt xuất sắc nhất của Iron Squad để tham gia thử thách mới – bóng né. 26 cầu thủ sẽ bước vào một cuộc cạnh tranh khốc liệt cho đến khi thành lập được một đội mạnh nhất được trang bị sức bền thể thao và sức mạnh tinh thần mạnh mẽ. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ thi đấu trước các vận động viên ngôi sao và huấn luyện viên bóng né huyền thoại!

programme.title: THIÊN SƯ NÚI MAO - MAOSHAN HEAVENLY MASTER
programme.desc: Tù nhân Chi bỏ trốn dưới sự giám hộ của Master Zhang, khiến người này bị trục xuất khỏi gia tộc của mình. Trên đường đi tìm Chi, Master Zhang đến một nơi mà nhiều người biến mất không lý do. Anh ta sớm phát hiện ra rằng chính Chi đã bắt họ trong quá trình huấn luyện để trở thành quỷ rắn. Cuộc chiến giữa con người và quỷ vừa mới bắt đầu!
